verdict.rationale: CockroachDB documents an official Cloud MCP server that lets AI tools explore live schemas and perform read and write operations (listing tables, executing statements, inserting rows) via OAuth/API-key auth, which supports agent-driven SQL work. However, there is no evidence of tool-level scoping that distinguishes read-only from destructive/write actions, nor any documented safety guardrails for schema-altering or destructive operations. missing for 10: explicit read-only vs write/destructive tool separation, permission scoping or confirmation gates for destructive schema/data operations, independent corroboration of safe agent delegation in practice.
